parameters.name: FtkAgentPrices3
parameters.label: Shared base query
parameters.description: Shared Agent framework hub price lookup, part 3 of 3. Workbooks have no baseQueries primitive and expand parameters only once, so the block is split around its cross-cluster references and each query rejoins the parts.
parameters.value:
.Prices
    | where SkuMeter endswith "1M Tokens" and PricingUnit == "Units"
    | where isnotnull(x_PricingBlockSize) and x_PricingBlockSize > 0
    | extend Tier = extract(meterRx, 4, SkuMeter), Scope = extract(meterRx, 5, SkuMeter)
    | extend Model = strcat("gpt-", replace_string(extract(meterRx, 1, SkuMeter), " ", "-")),
             Context = iff(extract(meterRx, 2, SkuMeter) == "LongCo", "long", "short"),
             Op = extract(meterRx, 3, SkuMeter)
    | join kind=inner billedCombos on Model, Tier, Scope
    | where x_EffectivePeriodStart <= now()
    | extend C = todouble(ContractedUnitPrice) / x_PricingBlockSize * 1000000.0,
             L = todouble(iff(isnull(ListUnitPrice) or ListUnitPrice <= 0, ContractedUnitPrice, ListUnitPrice)) / x_PricingBlockSize * 1000000.0
    | summarize C = max(C), L = max(L), IngestedAt = max(x_IngestionTime), Currency = take_any(PricingCurrency)
      by Model, Context, Op, x_EffectivePeriodStart, x_EffectivePeriodEnd
    | summarize arg_max(x_EffectivePeriodStart, *) by Model, Context, Op
    | summarize i = round(maxif(C, Op == "Inp"), 8), cr = round(maxif(C, Op == "Cd Inp"), 8),
                cw = round(maxif(C, Op == "Cd Wr"), 8), o = round(maxif(C, Op == "Opt"), 8),
                li = round(maxif(L, Op == "Inp"), 8), lcr = round(maxif(L, Op == "Cd Inp"), 8),
                lcw = round(maxif(L, Op == "Cd Wr"), 8), lo = round(maxif(L, Op == "Opt"), 8),
                pStart = min(x_EffectivePeriodStart), pEnd = max(x_EffectivePeriodEnd), ops = dcount(Op),
                pIngest = max(IngestedAt), pCur = take_any(Currency)
      by Model, Context
    | where ops == 4);
let price = toscalar(priceRows
    | extend ctx = bag_pack(Context, bag_pack("i", i, "cr", cr, "cw", cw, "o", o, "li", li, "lcr", lcr, "lcw", lcw, "lo", lo))
    | summarize ctxBag = make_bag(ctx) by Model
    | extend m = bag_pack(Model, ctxBag)
    | summarize b = make_bag(m) | project b);
let priceStart = toscalar(priceRows | summarize max(pStart));
let priceEnd = toscalar(priceRows | summarize min(pEnd));
let priceRowCount = toscalar(priceRows | count);
let priceIngested = toscalar(priceRows | summarize max(pIngest));
let priceCurrency = toscalar(priceRows | summarize take_any(pCur));
let pricesLoaded = priceRowCount > 0;

parameters.name: FtkAgentUsage
parameters.label: Shared base query
parameters.description: Shared Agent framework span attribution. Workbooks have no baseQueries primitive, so the definition lives here once and each query references {FtkAgentUsage}.
parameters.value:
let uniqueSpans = materialize(spans
| where array_length(pricing.services) == 0 or cloud_RoleName in~ (pricing.services)
| where name has 'invoke_agent' or tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']) in ('chat', 'execute_tool')
| summarize take_any(timestamp, name, duration, success, operation_ParentId, customDimensions) by cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, id
| extend projectId = tostring(customDimensions['microsoft.foundry.project.id']), agentId = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.id']), agentDisplayName = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']), agentVersion = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.version']));
let parents = uniqueSpans | where name has 'invoke_agent'
| summarize take_any(parentProject = projectId, parentAgentId = agentId, parentName = agentDisplayName, parentVersion = agentVersion) by cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, parentId = id;
let attributedSpans = materialize(uniqueSpans
| extend parentId = operation_ParentId
| lookup kind=leftouter parents on cloud_RoleName, operation_Id, parentId
| extend parentMatches = isnotempty(parentProject) and isnotempty(parentAgentId) and (isempty(projectId) or projectId =~ parentProject) and (isempty(agentId) or agentId =~ parentAgentId)
| extend projectId = coalesce(projectId, iff(parentMatches, parentProject, '')), agentId = coalesce(agentId, iff(parentMatches, parentAgentId, '')),
    agentDisplayName = coalesce(agentDisplayName, iff(parentMatches, parentName, ''), '(unnamed agent)'), agentVersion = coalesce(agentVersion, iff(parentMatches, parentVersion, ''))
| extend foundryName = extract(@'(?i)/accounts/([^/]+)/projects/', 1, projectId), projectName = extract(@'(?i)/projects/([^/]+)$', 1, projectId)
| extend identityComplete = isnotempty(foundryName) and isnotempty(projectName) and isnotempty(agentId)
| extend agentKey = iff(identityComplete, hash_sha256(strcat(tolower(projectId), '|', agentId)), hash_sha256(strcat('missing|', cloud_RoleName))),
    agentRunId = iff(parentMatches, parentId, ''), sessionId = tostring(customDimensions['microsoft.session.id']), tenantId = tostring(customDimensions['microsoft.tenant.id']));
let labelCounts = attributedSpans | summarize by agentKey, agentDisplayName | summarize identities = count() by agentDisplayName;
let namedSpans = attributedSpans
| lookup kind=leftouter labelCounts on agentDisplayName
| extend agentLabel = case(not(identityComplete), strcat(agentDisplayName, ' [identity missing; ', cloud_RoleName, ']'), identities == 1, agentDisplayName, strcat(agentDisplayName, ' / ', projectName, ' [', substring(agentKey, 0, 8), ']'));
let agentRuns = namedSpans | where name has 'invoke_agent';
let agentTools = namedSpans | where tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']) == 'execute_tool';
let agentUsage = materialize(namedSpans
| where tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']) == 'chat'
| extend model = replace_regex(coalesce(tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.response.model']), tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.request.model'])), @'-\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$', ''),
    provider = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.provider.name']),
    input = tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']),
    cached = coalesce(tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']), tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cached_tokens'])),
    written = coalesce(tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_write.input_tokens']), tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens'])),
    output = tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])
| extend contextTier = case(isnull(input), 'unknown', input > tolong(pricing.longContextTokens), 'long', 'short'),
    cacheValid = coalesce(input >= 0 and cached >= 0 and cached <= input, false),
    usageValid = coalesce(input >= 0 and cached >= 0 and written >= 0 and cached + written <= input and output >= 0, false)
| extend p = price[model][contextTier]
| extend pricingApplies = coalesce(pricesLoaded and identityComplete and (isempty(tostring(pricing.projectResourceId)) or projectId =~ tostring(pricing.projectResourceId)) and provider in~ ('microsoft.foundry', 'azure.ai.foundry', 'azure.ai.openai', 'azure.ai.inference')
    and timestamp >= priceStart and timestamp < priceEnd
    and todouble(p.i) >= 0 and todouble(p.cr) >= 0 and todouble(p.cw) >= 0 and todouble(p.o) >= 0, false)
| extend priced = pricingApplies and usageValid,
    inputRate = iff(pricingApplies, todouble(p.i), real(null)), cacheReadRate = iff(pricingApplies, todouble(p.cr), real(null)),
    cacheWriteRate = iff(pricingApplies, todouble(p.cw), real(null)), outputRate = iff(pricingApplies, todouble(p.o), real(null))
| extend inputCost = iff(priced, (input - cached - written) * inputRate / 1e6, real(null)),
    cacheReadCost = iff(priced, cached * cacheReadRate / 1e6, real(null)),
    cacheWriteCost = iff(priced, written * cacheWriteRate / 1e6, real(null)),
    outputCost = iff(priced, output * outputRate / 1e6, real(null))
| extend estimated_cost = inputCost + cacheReadCost + cacheWriteCost + outputCost,
    cacheBenefit = iff(priced, (cached * (inputRate - cacheReadRate) - written * (cacheWriteRate - inputRate)) / 1e6, real(null)));

parameters.name: selectedBillingCurrency
parameters.label: Currency
parameters.query:
{"version":"AzureDataExplorerQuery/1.0","queryText":"let months = toscalar(database('Ingestion').HubSettings | project toint(retention.final.months));
let currencies = Costs_v1_2
    | where ChargePeriodStart >= monthsago(iff(isempty(months), 24, months))
    | where isnotempty(BillingCurrency)
    | distinct BillingCurrency;
let currencyCount = toscalar(currencies | count);
currencies
| extend Label = BillingCurrency, _Order = 1
| union (
    print BillingCurrency = '', Label = '⚠️ All', _Order = 0
    | where currencyCount > 1
)
| order by _Order asc, Label asc
| project BillingCurrency, Label
| serialize
| extend selected = row_number() == 1
| project value=BillingCurrency, label=Label, selected","clusterName":"{HubClusterName}","databaseName":"{HubDatabase}"}
